Definition: properly, to distribute, i.e. determine by lot or magical scroll; by implication, to divine
BiblicalUsage: Divination is forbidden outright: no one in Israel may use divination, yet Saul in his desperation begs the woman at Endor to divine unto him by the familiar spirit, the king of Babylon stands at the parting of the way to use divination. Israel's own sins included divination and enchantments.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the ban is absolute because divination is a rival way of knowing, and God had already given His people prophets and His word. When Saul could not hear God, he bought a counterfeit answer, and that is the warning in the word.
